``` {r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```
``` {r}
penguins |> select(bill_length_mm:body_mass_g) |>  drop_na() |> round()
```
``` {r}
penguins |> group_by(species, island) |> nest()
```
``` {r}
penguins |> mutate(body_mass_lb = body_mass_g/453.592) |> select(species, island, body_mass_g) |> drop_na()
```
